goal: Disentangle which of the four recorded survey-method families accounts for the five previously established source-prevalence direction reversals among Q1 wetland categories, using a complete 15-subset observation-method lattice and source-anchored per-site species records.

source.study: Wenner et al. (2025), Global Ecology and Conservation 62 e03837, original data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115 CC BY 4.0
source.original_Q1: 27 sites, 351 source rows, 13 intervention, 6 control, 8 artificial; 9 native taxa

fixed_design.subsets: ALL 15 nonempty subsets of four methods, ordered by size and lexicographic original-method order; 4 singles, 6 pairs, 4 three-method panels, 1 full panel; do not search for preferred subset after outcome
fixed_design.positivity: at each original site × native species, positive if at least one raw observed source row in included methods has count>0 (Boolean OR), exact date/row unchanged; no new resampling
fixed_design.contrasts: 27 taxon×category contrasts; signs from integer site-count cross-product. Strict reversal only positive↔negative, excluding zeros/ties; all compared against full four-method source evidence
primary_endpoints: For each method subset: exact retained native-positive pairs out of full 144 and per-category positive pair counts, native site-level support and method-row day coverage
Number and identity of strict direction reversals across all 27 fixed taxon×category contrasts versus four-method full source
All four leave-one-method-out three-method panels: number/identity of native positives exclusively dependent on excluded method; contrast reversals
Evidence monotonicity certificate across 15 subset masks: A⊆B implies O(A)⊆O(B), source-positive must never be created
Minimal method-cardinality subsets that reproduce all 144 full native source-positive site×species pairs, if any
Minimal method-cardinality subsets that preserve exactly all 27 baseline category sign directions, noting that preserved signs do not imply full evidence recovery

Per-method positive witness exclusivity and Shapley-style allocation of each site×species positive among the k method families that detected it as 1/k each; explicit descriptive accounting, not ecology/mechanism attribution
deliverables: source-positive site×species (144 rows) method capture and exclusivity table
result JSON with fixed fingerprints, SHA checks, tests and source-grade nonclaims

stop: Post-exposure deterministic re-expression of the same source observations: no independent ecological replication or prospective hypothesis-test status.
Methods represented in the original CSV are not verified deployment; the paper describes dipnet in regular sessions while the CSV represents dipnet rows for a subset of site dates.
Method omission is missing source-positive evidence, never a biologically verified absence.
Subsets contain unequal observational channels/effort; do not compare them as equally sampled treatments or infer causal effects.
Shapley-style share is an accounting allocation among correlated recorded methods; not proportional detection probability, effort, mechanism or actual population size.
No occupancy likelihood, field-closure test, treatment effect, causal A/B/M, true number of compatible EOG worlds or new EOG-WF scored endpoint.
